chunks: Under which they will live, and their suffering will neither decrease nor be respite for them.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about the permanence and intensity of punishment in Hell?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the absolute finality of divine justice for the disbelievers, contrasting with the temporary nature of purgatorial punishment for believers with minor sins. The phrase 'laa yunzharoon' (no reprieve) signifies that their punishment is immediate and continuous, without any interim pause, reflecting the severity of their rejection of truth. This permanence serves as a stern warning against complacency in faith, emphasizing that the consequences of disbelief are eternal and unmitigated.
